name: agent-skills
description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
one_liner: A packaged set of best-practice checklists and slash commands that make AI coding assistants follow a senior engineer's workflow (spec, plan, build, test, review, ship) instead of writing sloppy code.
buyer: A CTO or engineering lead at a startup whose team's AI-generated code keeps needing rework.
business_use_cases: A startup engineering lead installs it org-wide so every developer's AI agent follows the same quality gates before merge, cutting review time and directly addressing 'AI writes bloated, over-engineered code.'
A coding bootcamp or course teaches it as the correct way to use AI agents professionally, as paid curriculum content.
A consultancy audits a client's AI-assisted dev workflow and installs or customizes this skill set as a paid engagement.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid course or workshop teaching teams how to adopt agent-driven development with these skills
Offer paid custom-skill development for companies wanting workflow-specific variants with their own style guide baked in

steal_this: This weekend, package a niche variant (tuned for a specific framework or industry) and sell it as a small paid install via the existing skills CLI ecosystem.
